name: Nue
source: Pathfinder Lost Omens Tian Xia World Guide

defensiveAbilities.name: Viper Tail
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within 15 feet of the nue leaves a square during a move action it's using or moves into a square that would cause the nue to become flanked

Effect The nue whips around and attempts a tail Strike against the triggering creature. This Strike doesn't count toward the nue's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Cloud Form
offensiveAbilities.description: The nue changes its shape into that of a dark storm cloud. In Cloud Form, the nue is Concealed, gains a 60-foot fly Speed, gains a +4 status bonus to its Deception DC to prevent others from seeing through its disguise, and can't make attacks, though it can use its howl abilities. The nue can Dismiss this effect.

offensiveAbilities.name: Monstrous Howl
offensiveAbilities.description:
The nue lets out an eerie howl that rattles creatures' very souls. Creatures within 60 feet must attempt a DC 27 Will Saving Throw save (DC 29 at night). They're then temporarily immune to Monstrous Howl for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes 2d8 Persistent,void Damage damage.

Failure As success, plus the target is Drained 1.

Critical Failure As success, plus the target is Drained 2 and Stunned 1.

offensiveAbilities.name: Thundering Howl
offensiveAbilities.description: The nue howls to the sky, calling down a bolt of lightning that strikes the creature closest to the nue, to a maximum range of 60 feet. The bolt deals 12d6 Electricity Damage damage (Basic DC 27 Reflex Saving Throw save). The nue then can't use Thundering Howl for 1d4 rounds.
